info.title: ShipWithAli Owner API
info.description: Authenticated, command-oriented Owner transport contract. The implemented slices cover Portfolio Configuration, content Publication, Project intent, controlled Taxonomy evolution, private Media acceptance, CV Portfolio history, and Feedback Moderation without exposing raw tables, provider objects, or runtime code.

tags.name: Configuration
tags.description: Owner intent for public profile, Contact channels, and Global project CTA.

tags.name: Publication
tags.description: Immutable Revisions and explicit per-language Public lifecycle commands.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Project maturity, editorial emphasis, durable routes, and curated relationships.

tags.name: Taxonomy
tags.description: Controlled vocabulary creation, assignment, rename, retirement, and merge.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Private upload intent, processing evidence, acceptance, rejection, and history.

tags.name: CV Portfolio
tags.description: English CV registration, acceptance, explicit Current CV activation, and history.

tags.name: Interaction and Moderation
tags.description: Feedback approval, rejection, later suppression, and preserved decision history.

Restores content only after all current publication validation succeeds.

get.description: Returns Project intent and durable route identity, not a raw table mirror.

post.description: Changes the Owner-defined work-state label without changing Public lifecycle.
Changes editorial emphasis without changing visibility or newest-published ordering.

post.description: Relates two distinct Projects without inferring an automatic recommendation.

get.summary: Inspect a Taxonomy and its value history
get.description: Returns active, retired, and merged value state as an aggregate view.

Changes the display name while preserving stable identity and history.

post.description: Rejects retired values and values from an incompatible Taxonomy.

get.summary: Inspect a Media asset and its acceptance history
get.description: Returns a provider-neutral application view, never storage credentials or provider objects.

post.description: Creates a new Media identity and an opaque short-lived target; upload is not acceptance.

201.description: Private upload intent created; the Media asset is not accepted.

post.description: Records provider-neutral detected properties and safety outcome before acceptance.
Accepts a safe processed asset only after its accessibility metadata is approved.

post.description: Records the rejection while retaining the Media acceptance history.

get.description: Returns retained versions and the explicit single Current CV pointer.

post.description: Registers a retained version from an accepted document Media asset without accepting or activating it.

201.description: CV version registered but not yet accepted or Current.

post.description: Accepts the version for possible Current CV activation without activating it.
Atomically makes one accepted English version Current while retaining all prior versions.

get.summary: Inspect private Feedback and Moderation history
get.description: Returns the Feedback aggregate and retained decisions, not a raw table mirror.

post.summary: Approve Feedback for eligible public display
post.description: Records approval while preserving the private submission and decision history.
Records rejection without deleting the private Feedback or prior decisions.
Removes public-display eligibility while retaining the Moderation decision history.

OwnerSession.name: sw_owner_session
OwnerSession.description: A server-verified Supabase session originating from GitHub OAuth. The authenticated actor must also match the configured Owner allowlist; authentication alone never grants Owner authorization.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Visible-ASCII client value scoped by operation and Owner. Exact replay returns the original safe result; conflicting reuse returns 409.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Quoted expected aggregate version used for optimistic concurrency.

StableId.description: Immutable UUIDv7 identity, independent of routes, labels, and providers.

revisions.description: Immutable Revision history ordered by sequence within each locale.

redirects.description: Retained former slugs and their current canonical target.

processingHistory.description: Retained processing attempts and findings in recorded order.

uploadTarget.description: Opaque, short-lived private upload target with no provider contract.

versions.description: Retained registration and acceptance history, including prior Current CV versions.

activationHistory.description: Retained Current CV activations in recorded order.

mediaId.description: Accepted document Media asset used by this retained CV version.

locale.description: Public Current CV is English-only in v1.

decisionHistory.description: Append-only approval, rejection, and suppression decisions in recorded order.

BadRequestProblem.description: The transport input is malformed or violates its declared shape.

UnauthenticatedProblem.description: The Owner session is missing, invalid, or expired.

ForbiddenProblem.description: The authenticated actor is not in the configured Owner allowlist.

NotFoundProblem.description: The requested aggregate does not exist.

ConflictProblem.description: The intent conflicts with identity, state, or idempotency history.

FailedPreconditionProblem.description: If-Match does not match the current aggregate version.

UnprocessableProblem.description: Valid transport input failed a publication, evidence, or domain rule.

RateLimitedProblem.description: The Owner operation exceeded its rate limit.

InternalProblem.description: An unexpected failure occurred without exposing internal detail.

TemporarilyUnavailableProblem.description: A required dependency is temporarily unavailable.
